units.source_text: “为K出殡回来的路上，K的一位朋友问我，K为什么自杀？

en.t: On the way back from K's funeral, one of K's friends asked me why K had killed himself.

units.source_text: 自事件发生以来，我不知多少次因这个问题而倍感折磨了。

en.t: Since the incident happened, I had been tormented by that question more times than I could count.

units.source_text: 从夫人和小姐、故乡赶来的K的父兄，到接到讣告的朋友们，乃至和K毫无干系的报社记者，全都向我提出过同样的问题。

en.t: From the mistress and the young lady, to K's father and elder brother who came from his hometown, to the friends who received the obituary notice, and even newspaper reporters with no connection to K at all, everyone asked me the same question.

units.source_text: 我的良心每次都像针扎一般刺痛难耐，

en.t: Each time, my conscience ached unbearably, as if it were being pricked by needles,

units.source_text: 因为透过这一提问，我听到了一个声音：‘赶快坦白是你杀死的吧！’

en.t: because through that question I heard a voice saying, 'Hurry up and confess that you killed him!'

units.source_text: 我的回答是千篇一律的，我只是重复一遍他留给我的遗书，此外一句多余的话也不说。

en.t: My answer was always the same: I simply repeated what he had written in the letter he left for me, and said not one word more.

units.source_text: 在葬礼的归途，提出同样问题，又得到同样回答的K的朋友，从怀里拿出一份报纸给我看。

en.t: On the way back from the funeral, K's friend, having asked the same question and received the same answer, took a newspaper from inside his coat and showed it to me.

units.source_text: 我一边走，一边看他指点的地方，上面写道：‘K是因为被父兄从家里赶出来，产生了厌世的念头而自杀的。’

en.t: As I walked, I looked at the place he pointed out; it said, 'K committed suicide because, after being cast out by his father and elder brother, he became weary of the world.'

units.source_text: 我一句话也没有说，把报纸叠好，还给了那个人。

en.t: Without saying a word, I folded the newspaper and returned it to him.

units.source_text: 他还告诉我，也有的报纸说，K是由于神经错乱而自杀的。

en.t: He also told me that some newspapers said K had killed himself because of mental derangement.

units.source_text: 因忙于丧事，近来我几乎没有工夫看报纸，所以这方面的消息一点也不知道，其实心里一直在担忧。

en.t: Because I had been busy with the funeral affairs, I had lately had almost no time to read the newspapers, so I knew nothing about such reports, though in truth I had been worrying about them all along.

units.source_text: 我最担心报上登出那些给小姐一家添堵的消息，特别是小姐，即便只是提及小姐的名字，也是令我不堪忍受的。

en.t: What I feared most was that the newspapers would print reports that would distress the young lady's household, and especially the young lady herself; even the mere mention of her name was more than I could bear.

units.source_text: 我问那位朋友，此外还登了什么？

en.t: I asked that friend whether anything else had been printed.

units.source_text: 他说他看到的只有这两种。

en.t: He said that those two kinds of reports were the only ones he had seen.
